items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: I know he used to play with Perez, Manuel Perez, years ago.

ctx.x: Yeah. We begin our fiesta with a tea in September. We begin in September. Around the third Sunday, September? The third Sunday. In September. And it's always at the Autopilot club. They give us that date. The club, members of the club, give us the hall for that date. And, oh, we have a lovely tea. Tables are decorated, you know. And the board members are all in their regalia. Their big hats, flowers, and they serve at the tea tables. And we have, last year, we really almost had a concert. We had such nice…
I know he used to play with Perez, Manuel Perez, years ago.
Professor Blanchett lives right at the next corner here.
